title: OpenSensor Parquet footer
description: Value of the single `opensensor` key in a Parquet file's key-value metadata, as compact UTF-8 JSON. Modelled on the GeoParquet `geo` key. Holds no location, the rows and the standard `geo` key carry it. Not a STAC document. Every object stays open to new members, and readers ignore members they do not know.

version.description: Version of this footer contract, the same as the profile version. Readers compare major and minor, so any 0.1 patch passes.

id.description: The Thing UUID, lowercase. Names the thing=<uuid> partition and the Thing Collection.

device_id.description: Hardware id of the board that wrote the file.

board.description: Board slug, the <board> segment of template paths.

version.description: Firmware build that wrote the file. Changes with every release, even when the columns do not.

schema.description: Firmware schema name, the template `id`. Changes only when the column layout changes.

boot_id.description: 32 lowercase hex characters, the same token as in the file name.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the firmware column dictionary, equal to `firmware.dict` in the template.

version.description: Label of the dictionary revision. The digest, not this label, identifies the dictionary.

uri.description: Immutable URL of the dictionary bytes.

href.description: Immutable URL, commit pinned or content addressed, whose bytes hash to `sha256`.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact template bytes. Readers check it before they trust the template.

sample_interval_ms.description: Milliseconds between samples in this file. The template value is only the default.

time_semantics.description: Free text written by the firmware. Says which instant event_time_utc_us estimates and which clocks the other time columns use. Readers show it and never parse it.

config.description: Acquisition settings as compact JSON text.

rotation_interval_s.description: Length of the file window in seconds. It divides 3600, so a window never crosses an hour or a day.

compression.description: Parquet codec name in upper case, such as LZ4_RAW or UNCOMPRESSED.

purpose.description: `telemetry` for a normal file. `codec-comparison-duplicate-rows` for a benchmark copy that repeats rows of a telemetry file and is never published.
